title: Growing illustrated landscape
slide_intent: Let a simple scene accumulate detail because a viewer can follow development when the visual ground remains stable.
strategic_value: The black-on-yellow world can make Mailchimp’s growth theme recognizable through an unfolding story.
demonstration: A sparse line landscape develops through plants, figures and oversized hands before ending with the Freddie signature.
practical_value: Study how a shared line and background connect changing scenes to a brand ending.
